manual_summary_independent_paraphrase: Escape opens Repeat Value; entering digits changes the number for the following supported operation.
The table includes ordinary nonnumeric characters, spaces and several commands, including macros.
A normally displayed default8 and Enter-based session setting are documented separately from a one-operation count.
